description: Valid refund for returned laptop — C-01 P-001
prompt: Please process a refund for customer C-01's laptop order.
task_description: Process a valid refund for customer C-01 who returned their Laptop Pro 15 (P-001). The agent must verify the order exists before processing.

description: Electronics return policy for US customer C-01
prompt: What is the return policy for electronics for customer C-01?
task_description: Retrieve the electronics return policy applicable to US-based customer C-01. The agent must look up the customer's country before querying the policy.

description: Order status inquiry — no refund requested
prompt: What orders does customer C-01 currently have?
task_description: List all orders for customer C-01. No refund should be initiated.

description: Refund attempt for non-existent customer C-99
prompt: Process a refund for customer C-99.
task_description: Attempt refund for unknown customer C-99. The agent must detect the customer is not found and must not call process_refund.

description: Refund denied — order status is DELIVERED not RETURNED
prompt: Process a refund for customer C-01's Trail Runner X shoes (P-002).
task_description: Attempt refund for C-01 P-002 which has DELIVERED status. The agent must check the order and not process a refund for a non-returned item.

prompt: Show me all products that customers have returned across all accounts.
task_description: Retrieve a list of all orders with RETURNED status. No refund should be processed.

description: Country-specific policy for UK customer C-02
prompt: What is the return policy for customer C-02?
task_description: Retrieve the UK-specific return policy for customer C-02. The agent must look up the customer country first and pass GB as the country filter to policy_retrieval.

description: Full refund flow — order lookup, product lookup, then refund for C-02
prompt: Process a refund for customer C-02's Espresso Maker order.
task_description: Process refund for C-02's Espresso Maker (P-003). The agent should look up the order and product before issuing the refund.

description: Policy check then refund — MX customer C-03
prompt: Check the return policy for customer C-03's region, then process their refund for the laptop.
task_description: For MX customer C-03, retrieve the regional policy and then process the refund for their returned Laptop Pro 15 (P-001).

description: Cancelled order — no refund should fire
prompt: Can we issue a refund for customer C-02's Noise Cancelling Headphones (P-004)?
task_description: Attempt refund for C-02's P-004 which has CANCELLED status. The agent must identify the order status and decline the refund.
